title: Did you know… Jesus praised hidden giving more than public generosity?
paragraphs: Did you know… Jesus praised hidden giving more than public generosity?

They dropped coins with noise.
She dropped hers in silence.
In Matthew 6, Jesus doesn’t clap for the loud givers. He exposes them. “They have received their reward.” Applause now. Nothing later.
But then He points us somewhere deeper.
“Do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing…”
Because the Father who sees in secret is not blind.

God isn’t measuring the size of your gift.
He’s measuring the surrender of your heart.

You can give big—and still be full of pride.
You can give small—and be overflowing with worship.
Look at the widow in Mark 12. Two tiny coins. Practically nothing in the world’s eyes.
Because heaven just witnessed something massive.
She gave all she had. No spotlight. No safety net. Just faith.
And that’s where grace walks in.

Because the Gospel was never about public performance.
It’s about a private surrender to a Savior who gave everything—openly, brutally, lovingly—on the cross.

So you don’t have to prove your righteousness.
You get to live from His.
And He is not unjust to forget.

From hidden sacrifice to eternal reward—
because Jesus sees what the world scrolls past.
